title: Intelligence Security Laboratories — office for MDL 7296 E + EXP 7224 E + ADD ENHDOOR 30. Room revised 19 Oct 2026 to the client's stated dimensions (Gregory Shelby's email to Jill). Supersedes the 16 Oct sketch estimate.
sources: Gregory Shelby email to Jill, received 19 Oct 2026 (room dimensions)
anchor: STATED, not scaled. Every wall run is a number from the client's email; the hand sketch supplies only the shape and which wall carries the beam. Email: narrowest 88 in; total length 177 in; the support beam juts out 27.5 in; widest 115.5 in; back wall to the beam 71 in; the wall where the beam is enclosed 28 in; entrance to the beam 78 in; height 96 in. Closures: 71 + 28 + 78 = 177 (left chain = total length); 88 + 27.5 = 115.5 (narrow + beam = widest).
interpretations: The 'support beam' is the return in the left wall drawn on the client's sketch (the jog). It juts 27.5 in into the room and its end face is 28 in long.

'Back wall' is read as the top wall on the sketch, the end with the blue alcove, so the alcove's left wall is 71 in. 'Entrance' is read as the bottom end, so the left wall from the bottom wall to the beam is 78 in. If the client meant the reverse, the beam moves 7 in along the left wall; nothing else changes.
The widest part, 115.5 in, is used for both the top and the bottom wall. The client gave one width for the full-width part of the room, so the room is taken as square-cornered.
Plan up = the top of the sketch, drawn as model +y. It is NOT true north; the sketch carries no north.

Origin [7.5, 180]: the room is placed so its top and right walls sit exactly where the 16 Oct estimate put them. The booth, its dimensions and every scene camera stay put; the booth keeps its 1 in gap to the top wall and its vent hardware stays 1 in off the right wall.

The room's own entry door is still NOT given. It stays ASSUMED: a 3'-0" x 6'-8" door in the bottom (entrance) wall at its right end, 4 in from the right corner to the near jamb, hinged on that jamb and swinging into the room toward the right wall.
No windows, furniture, columns or services are drawn because none were given.
